mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as policy easing expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production indicates strengthening manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of early-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that delays monetary easing, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as rate hike expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and CPI inflation signals hawkish monetary policy response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong quarterly GDP growth signals economic momentum that may trigger equity valuation peaks, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as slowdown expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0% in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
